businessGoal: Enable users to efficiently find specific products by category.

scenarios.goal: Verify that the correct category page is displayed with the relevant products and the category name as the page title.
Verify that all filters available in the product overview are present on the category page.

manual.reason: Functional testing is required to validate the user interactions on the category page.

api.reason: The story does not indicate any API behavior that can be validated.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria specify visible browser behavior, including page display and available filters.
